headline: Terminal-Bench audit reports task defects and budget effects that change agent scores
summary: A 5 November arXiv paper describes a continuous audit workflow and the Terminal-Bench 2.1 update to Terminal-Bench 2.0. The authors report repair issues in 28 tasks, score increases over 10 percentage points, changes of up to three leaderboard places and a 19-agent rank correlation of 0.958; they also report that extended time budgets shrink some fixed-budget harness gaps. The audit combines task files, execution traces, community reports, automated checks and maintainer-reviewed repairs. Its workflow precision/recall are retrospective because it helped construct the repair set. The linked public repository is accessible and lists an Apache-2.0 license, but its README says 26 tasks were modified, which does not match the paper’s 28-task count. Results are author-reported and were not independently reproduced here.
